source_dataset: Fresh autonomous validation from the already rejected corrective experiment: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two-player, 32 independent maps seed6351000, 154 sampled positions, 1054 candidate post-turn states, all games and candidate replies complete
verification: Opt-in per-candidate score export preserved the ordinary first-student audit byte-for-byte, SHA256 642e3fc3a5493b9e59e5256d555920041dedec3baa967df2f05c27134d509cba. Both opt-in reports used identical map/position order, native and static scores, and source-model autonomous scores. Native search was used only for offline comparison, not model inference.
interpretation: Absolute transformed successor-score error and decision quality diverge in this diagnostic: the corrective model's aggregate error increased for root seat zero, yet all three of its changed seat-zero root choices improved the native searched one-turn objective. Exact teacher-index agreement also overstates progress because one changed index has equal native reply score. Only four changes have strict native preference, with three favorable and one unfavorable across independent maps; the post hoc sign p=.625 provides no reliable strength evidence. This conditional one-turn objective is neither terminal outcome nor Elo.
decision: Retain the predeclared rejection of the corrective student. Do not tune on these maps, use reserved confirmation seed6352000 or final complete-game seed6300000, or deploy/rate this head. Before further direct action-head training, define a search-aware root-candidate ranking policy and a fresh independent-map gate that measures complete-game outcomes and runtime.
